desc: Implement compact rolling banded Levenshtein DP with correct diagonal-to-band index mapping and saturated costs.
Ensure early rejection for `abs(len(S)-len(T)) > K` and correct first-row/first-column boundary handling.
Verify all transitions (match, replacement, insertion, deletion), particularly at valid-band boundaries and on the final unequal-length diagonal.
Check runtime and memory suitability for lengths up to 500,000 and K up to 20.
